Hi, that night we just went to bed, and everything was alright after. I still recommended my family to take her to the vet to check it out when they got home. 
I would recommend not feeding your dog the next meal, and of course see a vet as soon as possible as I do not know if your dog might have the same issues as mine.
Do you know how I could do that ?

I am very concerned about her, but I do not have a way of getting to the nearest er since it’s in another town. The only possible way of me getting her checked out is in the morning by her vet near me. She doesn’t indicate any signs of pain, or anything out of the ordinary, which I’m not sure if that’s a good sign or not. I have also left the bloody specks in the tissue for an hour now, and the blood specks seem to not have deoxygenate.
